deep_analysis:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
TRADE WATCHDOG — WARNING
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

Open Trades: 3 (3 long, 0 short)
Unrealized PnL: +0.11 USDT
Regime: 5m aggregate LONG_BIAS (34L/7S/88N @22:30) | btc_15m LONG_BIAS | btc_4h SHORT_BIAS | regimes.BTC NEUTRAL | continuum ABOVE EMA300 80382 (+171, 546 min, LEAN_BULL, STRONG_UP) | auto-trader CHOP | Vol LOW (BTC ATR ~0.06%/1h), volume LOW, velocity SLOW, acceleration NEGATIVE
Flip rate: aggregate 17/24h, BTC 16/24h — inside calibrated band (full-log p50=19, p95=26), standing churn, NOT an anomaly. <6 has not occurred since Oct 2. Direction states survive ~1h → every steer below is condition-keyed and re-tested this cycle.

── Steers ──────────────────────────────────────
🔴 [profit_lock] HYPE #16383 — SL 75.7301 still entry-time, trailing_activated=False, hl_sl_order_id=None (verified in PostgreSQL 22:47). No automated manager owns this position, so nothing will ratchet it. It has now printed +0.74% MFE (max 1m close 76.52 vs entry 75.958; 93 of the last 299 minute-closes ≥ the +0.40% arm level 76.26) and round-tripped back to ~76.31 twice. Action: move SL 75.7301 → 75.958 (entry) while price ≥75.95. Re-tested 22:47: price 76.31-76.43, condition still holds. age=3 cycles unexecuted.
🔴 [regime] Hold all 3 LONGs only while BTC 1m holds above EMA300. Exit trigger = 3 consecutive 1m closes below it. Re-tested 22:44: price 80552.5 vs EMA300 80381.9, gap +171 (was +131), consecutive_below=0, ema300_duration 546 min, linreg LEAN_BULL (was NEUTRAL), trend_quality STRONG_UP. Condition strengthened, steer stands. age=3 cycles unexecuted.
🟡 [cluster] Portfolio is 100% one-way: 3 of 3 LONG, none armed (trailing_activated=False on all three). A single BTC dump that breaks EMA300 takes all three at once — and with no trail on any of them, none can ratchet into profit before it lands. Re-tested: still 3/3 long. age=3 cycles unexecuted.
🟡 [stale] HYPER #16387 (opened 22:37, pump-chain+, meta_rsi 55.56) sits in the worst combination in the book: LONG 45-60 band (44T/17W/38.6%/-1.36 over 7d) on pump-chain+ (14T/2W/-0.88 over 7d), ATR 0.23% in a LOW-vol tape — i.e. a chop-tier entry. Action: if no 1m close ≥ 0.064767 (+0.40%, trail arm) by 23:47 UTC, exit rather than hold an unarmed mid-band long; the shared EMA300 exit trigger applies on top. Current: max close 0.0647 (one tick from the arm level), 14/40 closes above entry.
🟢 [resolved] Retracted — "HYPE deadline 23:22 UTC (no close above 76.20 → cut)": condition reversed favorably at 22:27, 14 minute-closes ≥76.20 in the last hour (now 76.26-76.52). No cut triggered; superseded by the ratchet steer above.
🟢 [resolved] HBAR #16386 closed 22:38 at -0.49% (trail_arm_timeout) — the prior 22:42 deadline check is moot, not reissued. Its MFE never reached +0.40%, so the arm never had a chance to work.
🟢 [opportunity] STX SHORT pick (21:49) superseded — STX now RSI 78.79, outside the 45-65 short band. New pick this cycle: ZORA LONG — PICK (watchlist only — AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False, will NOT execute).

── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────
The book is three longs riding one condition. BTC has been above its 1m EMA300 for nine straight hours (+171 gap, LEAN_BULL, STRONG_UP), the 5m aggregate flipped SHORT_BIAS → LONG_BIAS within the last 30 minutes, and the auto-trader has called CHOP on all six of its recent decisions — a slow drift up on LOW volume, LOW volatility and NEGATIVE acceleration. That tape is real enough to hold the three longs, thin enough that it does not deserve a fourth from anything other than an arm's-length watchlist.

Position quality splits three ways, and only one piece is wrong. BTC #16385 entered at meta_rsi 5.48 — the LONG <35 bucket (4T/3W/+0.17) on continuum+ — correct side, 40/40 minute-closes above its 80292 entry, up +0.32%. HYPE #16383 entered at meta_rsi 26.79, also <35, and is up +0.51% with 38/40 closes above entry — the entry was right, the management is the failure: it crossed the trail arm threshold 93 times in five hours and nothing armed it, which is precisely the unarmed cohort where the -13.09 of the 14-day book lives (armed 135T/106W/78.5%/+9.93 vs unarmed 193T/16W/8.3%/-13.09). HYPER #16387 is the odd one out: mid-band RSI 55.56 on the single worst signal family of the week — the entry neither side of the book wants.

The last 24 hours were fine (10 closed / 7W / +0.77) and show no repeat-failure streak. The three losers are each a different failure mode and each has a clear winning side: HBAR -0.49% never armed (MFE +0.23% < the +0.40% threshold — the win was a coin that trends, and bb-bounce-v2-long+ at 18T/8W/-0.59 did not give it room); CHIP -1.63% was a SHORT at meta_rsi 63.01 — inside the 60+ short bucket that wins 67% — and gave it back through the profit-monster trail, so the winning side was a wider trail or no trail at all; BTC #16377 -3.42% was SHORT while BTC held above EMA300 the whole window (crossed above ~18:11, never crossed back) — the winning side was plainly LONG and we were on the wrong side of the same EMA300 that now governs all three open trades.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────
1. Ratchet HYPE #16383 SL 75.7301 → 75.958 now (price ≥75.95 re-tested 22:47). No automation will do it — verified no manager owns the position.
2. Keep the single regime trigger wired across all three: 3 consecutive 1m closes below EMA300 (80382) = exit all three. Re-tested 22:44, gap +171, still holding, age=3.
3. HYPER #16387: hard clock — no 1m close ≥0.064767 by 23:47 UTC means exit (unarmed mid-band long on a 2W/14T family); do not let it become a 6-hour chop hold.
4. New entries only at momentum extremes: SHORT meta_rsi 60+ (9T/6W/67%/+0.91) or LONG <35. Never mid-band 45-60 longs in LOW vol — that is the 44T/38.6%/-1.36 bucket and it is where HYPER sits.
5. Watchlist pick ZORA LONG written (watchlist only, AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False — will NOT execute).
